summary: Executed requested BOTH testing with backend regression rerun and deep enterprise landing frontend verification (tabs, URL persistence, anchors, content, pricing/form semantics, 3D behavior, responsiveness, and route regressions). Backend regression remains green (18/18). Frontend mostly passes with one critical 3D fallback gap under simulated WebGL-unavailable conditions.

ui_bugs.issue: When WebGL context creation is deliberately blocked in browser init script, fallback image (`enterprise-hero-3d-fallback`) does not render; a canvas still mounts. Expected bitmap fallback for WebGL-unavailable environments was not observed.

action_items: Investigate BusinessScene WebGL capability detection path and ensure deterministic fallback rendering when WebGL is unavailable (not only on explicit constructor throw/context-lost).
Re-verify `/api/resources` 503 behavior is still expected setup limitation and not surfaced as unexpected error in enterprise navigation contexts.
critical_code_review_comments: `BusinessScene` fallback currently depends on renderer-constructor failure or `webglcontextlost`; capability probing for unavailable contexts appears insufficient for forced-no-WebGL scenario.
Enterprise tab/content separation, truthful claims, tab-specific pricing semantics, and interest switching logic are implemented cleanly and consistently with requested behavior.
Backend enterprise lead estimate handling for agents (`quote_type: scope_based`) remains correct and admin rendering path is aligned.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on public URL from frontend/.env. Checked desktop 1920x800 and mobile 390x844 screenshots. Verified tabs (mouse + keyboard), `?view=` persistence across reload/back, panel exclusivity, hero copy/CTA by tab, course and agent anchor offsets, in-house CTA back-to-course, FAQ interactions, agent selector detail/case updates, pricing separation (course total shown only on course; none on agents), enquiry draft behavior (interest preselect by tab, contact fields retained across tab switches, draft cleared on edits/tab change), request flow without sending email, responsive overflow checks at 320/390/768/1024/1440/1920 (no horizontal overflow), and route regressions `/enterprise/programme`, `/resources`, `/`, `/courses`. 3D: hero and workbench canvases are nonblank; hero animation changes frame while playing and freezes when paused; workbench animation changes when in viewport; pointer drag/reset works; canvas counts remain stable after repeated tab switching (no canvas leak). Forced WebGL-block probe did not surface fallback image (potential bug).
rca of the issue: Reproduction: open `/enterprise?view=agents` in a fresh context with init script that blocks WebGL context creation, then inspect `[data-testid='enterprise-hero-3d-fallback']`. Observed `fallback_count=0` while a canvas still existed. Likely cause: fallback path only handles explicit constructor throw/context-lost and may not robustly detect all no-WebGL/browser capability failure modes. Mitigation: add explicit post-init renderer/context sanity checks (e.g., `renderer.getContext()` / capability checks) and switch to fallback when unusable; include a deterministic non-WebGL test harness in UI tests.
